purpose: Bind a family-owned long-form component plan to exact PDF bytes and page-level evidence without prescribing its visual composition.
rules: Every feature is explicit, including features not exercised by the proof.
Exercised features name one or more valid PDF pages and visible text anchors; not-run features have neither.
The table of contents may additionally require a minimum count of internal PDF links.
The auditor verifies the build report's exact PDF hash, page count, feature anchors and internal links.
Page-level text and link evidence does not replace visual review, source-rights review, browser review or physical print approval.
